title.narrative: Reducing Rural Poverty and Malnutrition Project II (RRPM II)

description.narrative: The project will continue to implement nutrition-sensitive CCT to contribute to reducing poverty and malnutrition, improve and enhance social protection systems, and promote planning, coordination, and monitoring of the Nutrition Convergence program. Component 1 will focus on strengthening the building blocks of a social protection system developed in the RRPM. Component 2 will finance cash transfers to eligible families as well as accompanying measures as SBCC. Component 3 will finance project management and institutional strengthening for the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. Component 4 will enhance the management capacity of the Ministry of Planning and Investment in planning, coordination, and monitoring the multi-sectoral Nutrition Convergence program. Component 5 is the Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC) with zero budget allocation.

To strengthen the social protection system and enhance the convergence of multisectoral interventions to improve nutrition behaviors in targeted areas, and in case of an eligible crisis or emergency, respond promptly and effectively to it.

title.narrative: Percentage of CCT beneficiaries receiving cash transfers regularly

comment.narrative: This indicator monitors the latest payment every six months. Numerator: Number of beneficiaries receiving cash grants according to program cycle. The program cycle shall follow the definition in the CCT Operations Manual. Denominator: Total number of beneficiaries eligible to receive payment.

title.narrative: Percentage of Children 6 – 23 months from CCT beneficiary household consuming foods from at least 5 out of 8 recommended food groups

comment.narrative:
Numerator: Children 6 - 23 months old from cash transfer beneficiary household who have reported to have consumed at least five out of eight recommended food groups during 24 hour preceding the time of the interview. Denominator: Total number of children 6 -23 months old from cash transfer beneficiary households.
This indicator can only be measured during the impact evaluation which is scheduled to happen in mid 2025.

title.narrative: Number of databases that are interoperable or integrated with PEDIS MIS

comment.narrative:
The number of government and/or non-government management information system that is integrated or interoperable with the PEDIS that manages information on Social Registry and Integrated Beneficiary Registry including CCT registry. Interoperable means that two or more systems can share data in a secure manner (e.g., through API, using online data sharing platform).
Department of Rural Development and Poverty Reduction (DRDPR) is working on getting the MoUs sign with DHIS2 and eCRVS databased. They are in the process of piloting the data interoperability offline. Once the MoUs are signed officially the data can be linked systematically.

title.narrative: Percentage of households in the CCT implementing area with complete socio-economic information updated no later than 3 years in the social registry

comment.narrative: Numerator: The number of households living in the CCT implementing areas, whose latest socio-economic information was validated and/or updated within the last 3 years from the indicator reporting time. Denominator: Estimated number of households living in the CCT implementing areas. The CCT implementing area means that the villages that has at least one CCT beneficiary at time of the indicator reporting.

title.narrative: Percentage of CCT beneficiary children under two years receiving growth monitoring and promotion services according to the standard monitoring schedule

comment.narrative: Numerator: Number of CCT beneficiary children under two years of age whose growth has been measured (that is, weight and height) and results plotted in their growth chart/pink book as per MOH growth monitoring and promotion procedures and schedule. Denominator: Total number of CCT beneficiary children under two years of age.

title.narrative: Percentage of CCT beneficiary households who participate in community nutrition sessions at least once per month

comment.narrative: Numerator: Number of beneficiaries (individuals) who attend the monthly community nutrition sessions at least once per month. Denominator: Total number of beneficiaries.

title.narrative: Percentage of pregnant women from cash transfer beneficiary households with at least 4 ANC checkups during their pregnancy

comment.narrative: Numerator: Number of CCTpregnant women who had at least 4 ANC visits (at health facilities or during health outreach sessions conducted byhealth staff). Denominator: Total numberof CCT pregnant women.

title.narrative: Shock Responsive Modality included in the Helping Hand Operations Manual

comment.narrative:
The Helping Hand Program operations manual which was developed under the RRPM does not include specific operational procedures in case of an emergency including natural disasters. The indicator can meet the target, when the operations manual is updated to include standardized operational procedures (SOPs) for an emergency – guiding potentially modified process on enrollment, compliance monitoring, grievance redressal and payment during and after an emergency.
The mission discussed to allocated some budget to hire individual consultant to work on develop procedure and integrated in CCT operation manual.
On-going. Adaptive Social Protection Workshop was organzied between May 15-16. During the workshop, MAF, MoLSW, MOF agreed to work together to develop a ASP guideline. This guideline will include procedure to deliver adaptive social protection cash transfers.

title.narrative: Percentage of beneficiaries satisfied with program implementation

comment.narrative:
Numerator: Number of CCT beneficiaries responding to the beneficiary survey that they are satisfied with the program implementation. Denominator: Total number of beneficiaries responding to the beneficiary survey under the project.
The project will prepare the term of reference to hire a firm to do the spot check in 2026.

title.narrative: Percentage of project districts using Child Scorecard to inform annual district development plan

comment.narrative:
The indicator will measure the use of CSC data to inform planning process as measure for accountability. Enumerator: number of districts using Child Scorecard to inform annual district development plan. Denominator: total number of targeted districts (targeted areas).
Child Scorecard would be the tool to inform this figure. As of now, MPI has completed piloting the CSC tools, they are planning to scale up to all targeted villages. By end of this year, the project will be able to provide information for this indicator.

title.narrative: Percentage of villages reporting Child Scorecard to track convergence of nutrition interventions

comment.narrative:
Numerator: Number of villages implementing the Child Score Card. Denominator: Total number of targeted villages (targeted areas).
Child Scorecard would be the tool to inform this figure. As of now, MPI has completed piloting the CSC tools, they are planning to scale up to all targeted villages. By end of this year, the project will be able to provide information for this indicator.

title.narrative: Percentage of first 1,000-day households with access to a package of convergent nutrition interventions in targeted districts

comment.narrative:
Numerator: number of 1,000 -day households in targeted districts that have received the complete package of priority nutrition interventions. Denominator: total number of 1,000 day households registered in the Child Scorecard.
Child Scorecard would be the tool to inform this figure. As of now, MPI has completed piloting the CSC tools, they are planning to scale up to all targeted villages. By end of this year, the project will be able to provide information for this indicator.

title.narrative: Percentage of villages where complementary SBCC is being delivered

comment.narrative: Numerator: Number of villages where complementary SBCC is being delivered. Denominator: Total number of targeted villages (targeted areas).

title.narrative: Percentage of project districts convening a multi-sectoral nutrition coordination meeting at least once every three (3) months

comment.narrative:
This indicator will measure the functionality of oversight and coordination mechanism. Numerator: number of districts convening a multi-sectoral nutrition coordination meeting at least once every three (3) months, Denominator: Total number of targeted districts (targeted areas).
This indicator is progressing, but this activity will be reflected in approximately 12 months.

title.narrative: Percentage of CCT beneficiaries (benefit recipient) who receive cash transfers through bank accounts or e-wallets

comment.narrative: Numerator: Number of CCT benefit recipients (grantees) who receive program benefits through digital means (i.e. transfer to beneficiary account, e-wallet, debit or cash card). Denominator: Total number of CCT benefit recipients (grantees).

title.narrative: Percentage of CCT-related grievances addressed and/or resolved within the stipulated service standards for response times

comment.narrative: Numerator: Total number of grievance cases from the CCT Program beneficiaries addressed in accordance to established protocol defined in the CCT operations manual. Denominator: Total number of grievance cases received from the CCT Program beneficiaries.

title.narrative: Number of programs and/or projects using information from social registry

comment.narrative:
Number of Government, International Organization or NGO programs or schemes, making use of the social registry data to plan implementation or identify potential areas and/or beneficiaries of their projects/programs.
Department of Rural Development and Poverty Reduction (DRDPR) signed MoU with National Health Insurance Bureau to share social registry data to identify who are eligible for national health insurance. DRD also shared social registry date with CLEAR project and WFP but no MoUs signed. DRD only received official request letter.

title.narrative: Beneficiaries of social safety net programs

comment.narrative:
The project continue enroll the new beneficiaries in the existing provinces and districts. The enrollment for new districts and provinces expect to happen by end of this year. Once this happens, number of cumulative beneficiaries will be increase rapidly.
The indicator is still on track to achieve the end target
